caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron skillet with a long handle, rendered in shades of dark brown and black. The skillet has a divided interior, featuring six equally spaced, rounded triangular sections radiating from a central star-shaped compartment. Each section forms a petal-like shape, and all compartments are recessed into the base of the pan. The handle extends from the right side and has an oval cutout near the end. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present. The artist’s signature, "N. Tampona," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Muffin Pan
